canvas.label: Graph canvas
canvas.hint: Arrow keys move between items. Enter opens. N adds an item after the focused one. C starts connecting: pick a target with the arrow keys, then Enter to confirm or Escape to cancel. Delete removes. Alt plus arrow keys moves an item.
